answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy enforces cryptographic stake burning where the nth identity must burn stake scaling superlinearly as O(n^2). While cheap copper tokens might bootstrap initial nodes, multiplying fake agents turns low cost into a fable, as quadratic burn imposes relentless economic friction. Cloaking identities in a velvet glove of proxy diversity fails because attacker cost escalates exponentially against cumulative consensus rewards.
